# Write development documentation

1. Read [Maintained document quality](../../knowledge/documentation/maintained-document-quality.md)
   before deciding the document's authority, structure, and reader route.
2. Inspect the requested change and choose the smallest coherent documentation
   response. Stop and report an unresolved decision when the required authority
   cannot be established.
3. For authorized delivery, follow
   [Deliver the documentation](references/deliver-documentation.md), apply the
   selected revision, and verify the resulting route.
4. Return the updated document and a completion report only after the delivery
   checks succeed. Otherwise return the observed blocker and unfinished work.
